Tucson, Arizona · eat

Restaurants in Tucson for cyclists

Where to eat in Tucson the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

For: El Tour de Tucson.

Restaurants in Tucson for cyclists, listed

  1. El Charro Cafe (Downtown)

    Sonoran Mexican · 311 N Court Ave, Tucson, AZ 85701

    Same family since 1922; carne seca is the dish. Open 11 am to 9 pm daily

  2. Cup Cafe at Hotel Congress

    American cafe · 311 E Congress St, Tucson, AZ 85701

    Breakfast from 8 am and dinner till 9 pm downtown; closes 2-4 pm

  3. BOCA by Chef Maria Mazon

    Tacos, modern Mexican · 533 N 4th Ave, Tucson, AZ 85705

    Scratch tortillas and daily salsas on Fourth Avenue; dog-friendly patio

  4. Seis Kitchen (Mercado San Agustin)

    Regional Mexican · 130 S Avenida del Convento, Tucson, AZ 85745

    Breakfast, lunch and dinner from 8 am daily in the Mercado courtyard, right on the Loop west of downtown

  5. Tumerico

    Latin vegan and vegetarian · 2526 E 6th St, Tucson, AZ 85716

    Chef Wendy Garcia's changing menu; a midtown stop for plant-based riders

  6. Barrio Bread

    Bakery · 18 S Eastbourne Ave, Tucson, AZ 85716

    Don Guerra's James Beard-winning sourdough; Tuesday-Saturday 9 am to 1 pm or until sold out
